name: Poking Boop again and again keeps it angry
case: The person pokes Boop again and again, then again a minute later, and again a minute after that. Boop gets angry at the first streak and answers every streak with a grumpy face (never a happy, excited or proud one), with a word like 'nope', 'ugh' or 'again', or none, and stays grumpy while the poking goes on. A few minutes after the last poke it has calmed down: when the agent starts a turn, Boop is happy again.
why: PERSONALITY's Examples: a poke streak gets a grumpy face with 'nope'; plan/steering/mood/happy.md and grumpy.md: a poke streak makes Boop grumpy, and grumpy goes back to happy 2 minutes after the change. A streak wakes the brain at most once a minute (harness/EVENTS.md §4), so the streaks are over a minute apart
